name: A Karvess Glass Shard

rarity.note: True echo-material from the Sundering itself; Censer-listed.

summary: A shard of the glass that was once Karvess — a person, a fountain, or a tower, no one can tell from a fragment. It hums against the teeth and gives shared dreams to those who keep it close: always the same dream, always the city's last morning. Possession is a crime under Censer writ; possession of a *face* shard is something worse than crime.
origin: 1 Sun (spring) — vitrified in the Rent's first hour
current_whereabouts: Dozens of shards in private hands despite the writ; the Glass-Keepers recover what they can.
properties: Hums the towers' note, faintly — the same tone heard at Hallord's shaft and past the Veiled Sea
Shared dreams among those who sleep within arm's reach of it
Face shards dream in the first person
keepers: Glass-Keepers confiscate; collectors pay; the Mile brokers both.
value_or_danger: Two hundred crowns for plain shard. A face shard: not purchasable — only inheritable, and only by accident.
adventure_hooks: Players' shared dreams begin diverging: each sees the same morning from a different witness's eyes. The shards are comparing notes.
A face shard's dream-person completes an action they never finished in life — and the shard cracks.
